
# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the online version of the work-in-progress **3rd edition** of *ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis*, published by Springer.

You can learn what's changed from the 2nd edition in the [Preface](#preface-3e).

While this book gives some details on the basics of ggplot2, its primary focus is explaining the Grammar of Graphics that ggplot2 uses and describing it in full detail.

It is not a [cookbook](https://r-graphics.org), and it won't necessarily help you create any specific graphic that you need. However, it will help you understand the underlying theory, giving you the knowledge to tailor any plot to your needs.

The book is written by [Hadley Wickham](http://hadley.nz), [Danielle Navarro](https://djnavarro.net), and [Thomas Lin Pedersen](https://www.data-imaginist.com).

## About This Repository

This repository is a personal fork of the original [ggplot2 book source repository](https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2-book).

It is used for learning R, exploring statistical graphics, understanding the Grammar of Graphics, and practising responsible open-source documentation contributions.

The original book content, intellectual work, and authorship remain attributed to the original authors and contributors.
